description: Type the 502 `gateway_error` a subdomain rename gets on a transient routing error. The spec documents it on UpdateSandboxRequest.subdomain ("On a transient routing error the rename is saved but returns 502 `gateway_error` - retry with the same value to finish activating routes"). Its httpError 502 keeps it a retried server error, as Boat asks. Source: spec-mirror-boat-dev 71ab00f.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The subdomain rename was saved but routes did not activate. Retry with the same value.
